question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Dense
solution:
The correct answer is: **Sparse**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Dense"** means something that is closely compacted in substance; thick. (घना)

 
 
• **Example: **The forest was so dense that sunlight barely penetrated through the canopy.
 
 
 
• **"Sparse" **refers to something that is thinly dispersed or scattered; not dense. (विरल)
 
 
• **Example: **The vegetation in the desert is sparse due to the lack of water.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Dense' **is **'Sparse'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Sparse**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Opaque **(अस्पष्ट): Not able to be seen through; not transparent.

 
 
• **Example:** The glass was opaque, preventing any light from passing through.
 
 
 
• **Closed **(बंद): Not open.
 
 
• **Example: **The store was closed for the holidays.
 
 
 
• **Thick** (मोटा): Having a large distance between opposite sides; not thin.
 
 
• **Example:** The book was very thick, with over a thousand pages.
